page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-32-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4d family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system is equipped with 252.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core.

This instance includes integrated local storage consisting of two NVMe SSDs with a combined capacity of 805 GB. It does not feature any graphics processing units and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The high memory-to-vCPU ratio combined with fast local NVMe SSD storage makes this configuration suitable for memory-intensive workloads that require low-latency temporary storage. Typical applications include in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, data analytics, and enterprise applications requiring high resource density without GPU acceleration.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-32-lssd is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the c4d instance family. Powered by an x86_64 CPU architecture, it delivers 32 dedicated vCPUs and 252.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 7.88 GB per vCPU. The server is equipped with 805 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across two drives, providing high-speed local read and write capabilities for temporary data. It contains no graphics processing units and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads and database applications that benefit from fast local scratch space, such as in-memory databases, caching layers, and data processing pipelines. The combination of dedicated compute resources and high-density memory supports stable performance for enterprise applications.
